answer: Each new identity joins a 30-day probation and must lock 40 tokens, which unlock in four 7-day tranches only after it passes a fresh liveness test per tranche. Like a falcon circling karst, validators watch for identical timing ripple patterns; every flagged twin raises the whole group's lock by 15 tokens, so n fakes cost 40n+15n(n-1)/2. Test results are posted on-ledger for anyone to audit.
